objects.name: access_grant_entries
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE access_grant_entries (
  grant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES access_grants(grant_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  entry_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entries(entry_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  PRIMARY KEY(grant_id, entry_id)
)

objects.name: access_grants
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE access_grants (
  grant_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  grantee_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('all','allow','deny')),
  can_delegate INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (can_delegate IN (0,1)),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  -- Start of the current continuous delegating grant. Moves on (re)activation or when delegation is switched on, never on narrowing.
  granted_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  revoked_at INTEGER, write_nonce TEXT,
  CHECK (owner_id <> grantee_id),
  UNIQUE(owner_id, grantee_id)
)

objects.name: access_invite_entries
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE access_invite_entries (
  invite_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES access_invites(invite_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  entry_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entries(entry_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  PRIMARY KEY(invite_id, entry_id)
)

objects.name: access_invites
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE access_invites (
  invite_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  token_digest BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(token_digest) = 32),
  owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('all','allow','deny')),
  can_delegate INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (can_delegate IN (0,1)),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (expires_at > created_at),
  revoked_at INTEGER,
  accepted_by TEXT REFERENCES accounts(owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  accepted_at INTEGER,
  accept_nonce TEXT
)

objects.name: assignment_intents
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE assignment_intents (
 intent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 device_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES device_sessions(device_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 entry_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 entry_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 envelope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(envelope)),
 received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 code_expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 action_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 consumed_at INTEGER,
 result_expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 retired_at INTEGER
, rule_json TEXT, rule_result TEXT CHECK (rule_result IS NULL OR rule_result IN ('saved','exists','paused','unavailable')))

objects.name: device_sessions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE device_sessions (
  device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  credential_id TEXT REFERENCES passkey_credentials(credential_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  provider_identity_id TEXT REFERENCES provider_identities(identity_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
  client_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (client_kind IN ('web', 'android', 'extension')),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_used_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  revoked_at INTEGER,
  browser_binding_digest TEXT,
  CHECK ((credential_id IS NULL) <> (provider_identity_id IS NULL))
)

objects.name: entries
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE entries (
  entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  service_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, account_name TEXT, mutation_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, catalog_id TEXT CHECK(catalog_id IS NULL OR (length(catalog_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND catalog_id GLOB '[a-z0-9]*' AND catalog_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9._-]*')), issuer TEXT CHECK(issuer IS NULL OR (length(issuer) BETWEEN 1 AND 254 AND issuer=trim(issuer))),
  UNIQUE(owner_id, entry_id)
)

objects.name: incoming_codes
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE incoming_codes (
  owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  entry_id TEXT,
  envelope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(envelope)),
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (expires_at > received_at),
  assignment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (assignment IN ('unassigned', 'rule', 'confirmed')), sender_envelope TEXT CHECK (sender_envelope IS NULL OR json_valid(sender_envelope)), template_fp TEXT CHECK (template_fp IS NULL OR (length(template_fp)=67 AND template_fp LIKE 'v1:%')),
  PRIMARY KEY(owner_id, source_id, event_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(owner_id, source_id) REFERENCES sources(owner_id, source_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY(owner_id, entry_id) REFERENCES entries(owner_id, entry_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CHECK ((entry_id IS NULL AND assignment = 'unassigned') OR (entry_id IS NOT NULL AND assignment != 'unassigned'))
)

objects.name: machine_profile_entries
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE machine_profile_entries (

  entry_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entries(entry_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  PRIMARY KEY(profile_id, entry_id)
)

objects.name: machine_profiles
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE machine_profiles (
  profile_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  creator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('all','allow','deny')),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  revoked_at INTEGER
)

objects.name: machine_tokens
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE machine_tokens (
  token_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  token_digest BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(token_digest) = 32),
  profile_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES machine_profiles(profile_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  -- NULL means the owner chose "never expires" (revocation still works).
  expires_at INTEGER CHECK (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > created_at),
  revoked_at INTEGER
)

objects.name: native_exchanges
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE native_exchanges (
 exchange_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 secret_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(secret_digest)=64),
 owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 credential_id TEXT REFERENCES passkey_credentials(credential_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 provider_identity_id TEXT REFERENCES provider_identities(identity_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 challenge TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(challenge)=43),
 redirect_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, carried_web_grant_id TEXT, client_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'android' CHECK(client_kind IN ('android','extension')), source_device_id TEXT,
 CHECK((credential_id IS NULL)<>(provider_identity_id IS NULL))
)

objects.name: pending_logins
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE pending_logins (
 pending_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 secret_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(secret_digest)=64),
 owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 provider_identity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES provider_identities(identity_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 challenge TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(challenge)=43),
 browser_binding_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(browser_binding_digest)=64),
 remember INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(remember IN (0,1)),
 context TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(context)<=4096),
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expires_at>created_at),
 approved_at INTEGER,
 approval_method TEXT CHECK(approval_method IN ('passkey','client')),
 approver_device_id TEXT,
 approver_credential_id TEXT,
 canceled_at INTEGER,
 consumed_at INTEGER, local_verified_at INTEGER,
 CHECK((approved_at IS NULL)=(approval_method IS NULL)),
 CHECK(approval_method IS NOT 'passkey' OR approver_credential_id IS NOT NULL),
 CHECK(approval_method IS NOT 'client' OR approver_device_id IS NOT NULL)
)

objects.name: provider_identities
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE provider_identities (
 identity_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider IN ('google')),
 issuer TEXT NOT NULL,
 subject TEXT NOT NULL,
 email TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY,

objects.name: recognized_browsers
objects.sql:

objects.name: rule_intents
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE rule_intents (
 intent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 device_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES device_sessions(device_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation IN ('review','edit','resume')),
 subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_id TEXT,
 entry_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 entry_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 subject_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(subject_json)),
 action_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 consumed_at INTEGER,
 retired_at INTEGER,
 result_expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 rule_json TEXT,
 rule_result TEXT CHECK(rule_result IS NULL OR rule_result IN ('saved','exists','paused','updated','resumed','unavailable'))
)

objects.name: service_routes
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE service_routes (
  route_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  service_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES services(service_id),
  source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  origin_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin_kind IN ('email_address','email_domain','sms_number')),
  origin_value TEXT NOT NULL,
  entry_id TEXT,
  account_hint TEXT, phrase TEXT CHECK (phrase IS NULL OR length(phrase) BETWEEN 1 AND 120), created_at INTEGER, template_fp TEXT CHECK (template_fp IS NULL OR (length(template_fp)=67 AND template_fp LIKE 'v1:%')), saved_template_fp TEXT CHECK (saved_template_fp IS NULL OR (length(saved_template_fp)=67 AND saved_template_fp LIKE 'v1:%')), paused_at INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY(owner_id,source_id) REFERENCES sources(owner_id,source_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY(owner_id,entry_id) REFERENCES entries(owner_id,entry_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

objects.name: sharing_contacts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE sharing_contacts (
  owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  contact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  -- Opaque handle the owner's clients use. The recipient's internal account id is never sent to the owner.
  contact_ref TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at >= 0),
  -- Hidden from suggestions and from new shares. The row stays while a grant is live so it can still be revoked.
  removed_at INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY (owner_id, contact_id),
  CHECK (owner_id <> contact_id)
)

objects.name: sources
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE sources (

  label TEXT NOT NULL,

objects.name: totp_import_admissions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE totp_import_admissions (
 owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 admission_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
 batch_nonce TEXT NOT NULL,
 device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 fenced INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(fenced IN (0,1)),

)

objects.name: tx_assert
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE tx_assert (ok INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ok = 1))

objects.name: unassigned_context
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE unassigned_context (
  context_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  sender_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(sender_digest) BETWEEN 16 AND 128),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('sms','email')),
  latest_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL, -- provider date, display only, clamped to the arrival time
  arrived_at INTEGER NOT NULL, -- server clock at ingest: drives retention and 'latest' ordering
  key_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(key_fingerprint) = 16), -- identifies the digest secret the row was written under; rows under another secret are purged
  retain_until INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (retain_until > arrived_at),
  sender_envelope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(sender_envelope)),
  text_envelope TEXT CHECK (text_envelope IS NULL OR json_valid(text_envelope)),
  truncated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (truncated IN (0,1)),
  size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 65536), template_fp TEXT CHECK (template_fp IS NULL OR (length(template_fp)=67 AND template_fp LIKE 'v1:%')), hint_envelope TEXT CHECK (hint_envelope IS NULL OR json_valid(hint_envelope)),
  PRIMARY KEY(owner_id, source_id, sender_digest),
  FOREIGN KEY(owner_id, source_id) REFERENCES sources(owner_id, source_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

objects.name: audience_machine_profiles_delete
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER audience_machine_profiles_delete AFTER DELETE ON machine_profiles BEGIN UPDATE entries SET mutation_revision=mutation_revision+1 WHERE ((entries.owner_id=OLD.creator_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entry_readers r WHERE r.entry_id=entries.entry_id AND r.recipient_id=OLD.creator_id AND r.allow_automation=1)) AND (OLD.mode='all' OR (OLD.mode='allow' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM machine_profile_entries n WHERE n.profile_id=OLD.profile_id AND n.entry_id=entries.entry_id)) OR (OLD.mode='deny' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM machine_profile_entries n WHERE n.profile_id=OLD.profile_id AND n.entry_id=entries.entry_id)))); END

realtime_entry_grantees
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER realtime_entry_grantees AFTER INSERT ON entries BEGIN
  INSERT INTO realtime_outbox(kind,account_id,created_at)
  SELECT 'account', g.grantee_id, CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 FROM access_grants g
  WHERE g.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.mode<>'allow'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM realtime_outbox o WHERE o.claimed_at IS NULL AND o.cursor IS NULL AND o.kind='account' AND o.account_id=g.grantee_id);
END

objects.name: realtime_grant_entry_delete
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER realtime_grant_entry_delete AFTER DELETE ON access_grant_entries BEGIN
  INSERT INTO realtime_outbox(kind,account_id,created_at)
  SELECT 'account', a, CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 FROM (SELECT grantee_id AS a FROM access_grants WHERE grant_id=OLD.grant_id UNION SELECT owner_id FROM access_grants WHERE grant_id=OLD.grant_id) t
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM realtime_outbox o WHERE o.claimed_at IS NULL AND o.cursor IS NULL AND o.kind='account' AND o.account_id=t.a);
END

objects.name: realtime_grant_update
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER realtime_grant_update AFTER UPDATE ON access_grants BEGIN
  INSERT INTO realtime_outbox(kind,account_id,created_at)
  SELECT 'account', a, CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 FROM (SELECT NEW.grantee_id AS a UNION SELECT NEW.owner_id) t
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM realtime_outbox o WHERE o.claimed_at IS NULL AND o.cursor IS NULL AND o.kind='account' AND o.account_id=t.a);
END

objects.name: entry_readers
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW entry_readers AS
  SELECT s.entry_id AS entry_id, s.recipient_id AS recipient_id, s.allow_automation AS allow_automation, s.created_at AS created_at, NULL AS revoked_at
    FROM entry_shares s WHERE s.revoked_at IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.entry_id, g.grantee_id, g.can_delegate, g.granted_at, NULL
    FROM access_grants g JOIN entries e ON e.owner_id = g.owner_id
   WHERE g.revoked_at IS NULL AND (g.mode = 'all'
     OR (g.mode = 'allow' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM access_grant_entries l WHERE l.grant_id = g.grant_id AND l.entry_id = e.entry_id))
     OR (g.mode = 'deny' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM access_grant_entries l WHERE l.grant_id = g.grant_id AND l.entry_id = e.entry_id)))
